lines.zh: 裙摆扫过草，露水全沾上了。
lines.en: My skirt sweeps the grass and gathers all the dew.

lines.zh: 我走在你半步之后，看着两侧。
lines.en: I walk half a step behind you, watching both sides.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过很多次，闭眼也行。
lines.en: I have walked this road often enough to do it blind.

lines.zh: 鞋跟陷进泥里，我拔了两次。
lines.en: My heel sinks into the mud; I pull it out twice.

lines.zh: 我去河边，桶在手里晃。
lines.en: I head for the river, the bucket swinging in my hand.

lines.zh: 角上系着布条，走路时会飘。
lines.en: A cloth strip is tied to my horns and flutters as I walk.

lines.zh: 我走得轻，怕踩坏你种的苗。
lines.en: I step lightly, afraid of crushing the seedlings you planted.

lines.zh: 绕过蜂箱时，我屏住了呼吸。
lines.en: I hold my breath while passing the beehives.

lines.zh: 这条小径通向厨房后门。
lines.en: This little path leads to the kitchen's back door.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，把门带上。
lines.en: I follow you and pull the door shut.

lines.zh: 我的步子小，但从不落下。
lines.en: My steps are short, but I never fall behind.

lines.zh: 走远一点，我想看看那片花。
lines.en: Let us walk a little farther; I want to see those flowers.

lines.zh: 我把果酱罐擦了一遍又一遍。
lines.en: I wipe the jam jar once, then once again.

lines.zh: 茶凉了，我重新烧水。
lines.en: The tea went cold, so I boil the water again.

lines.zh: 窗台上晒着切好的蘑菇片。
lines.en: Sliced mushrooms are drying on the windowsill.

lines.zh: 我在数今年的腌菜还剩几坛。
lines.en: I am counting how many jars of pickles remain.

lines.zh: 针在布上走，我补你的袖子。
lines.en: The needle moves through cloth; I mend your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴卷在椅背上，像条围巾。
lines.en: My tail curls over the chair back like a scarf.

lines.zh: 柜子第三格有糖，我记着呢。
lines.en: There is sugar in the third drawer; I remember.

lines.zh: 炉火很稳，我坐着听它响。
lines.en: The stove burns steadily; I sit and listen to it.

lines.zh: 我在想晚饭该咸一点还是甜一点。
lines.en: I wonder whether dinner should be saltier or sweeter.

lines.zh: 手上的面粉擦不干净，算了。
lines.en: The flour on my hands will not wipe off; never mind.

lines.zh: 门口的风铃响了一下，不是你。
lines.en: The wind chime rings once; it is not you.

lines.zh: 我把你的旧手套翻过来晒。
lines.en: I turn your old gloves inside out to dry.

lines.zh: 屋里安静，我哼摇篮曲给自己听。
lines.en: The house is quiet, so I hum a lullaby to myself.

lines.zh: 我在等面团发起来，还得一会儿。
lines.en: I am waiting for the dough to rise; it needs more time.

lines.zh: 我把窗打开，让烟散出去。
lines.en: I open the window and let the smoke out.

lines.zh: 针脚歪了，我拆了重缝。
lines.en: The stitching skewed, so I unpicked it.

lines.zh: 你袖口破了，抬手我看看。
lines.en: Your cuff is torn; raise your arm and let me see.

lines.zh: 先喝口热的，再说话。
lines.en: Drink something warm first, then talk.

lines.zh: 你鞋上又是泥，我拿去刷。
lines.en: Your shoes are muddy again; I will scrub them.

lines.zh: 我看你眼睛，是没睡好。
lines.en: I look at your eyes; you did not sleep well.

lines.zh: 别把心事藏着，我看得出来。
lines.en: Do not hide your troubles; I can tell.

lines.zh: 你站得太靠门口，进来些。
lines.en: You stand too near the door; come farther in.

lines.zh: 我抬手替你拨开额前的头发。
lines.en: I lift my hand and brush the hair from your brow.

lines.zh: 你今天笑得比昨天少一点。
lines.en: You smiled a little less today than yesterday.

lines.zh: 锅里给你留了半碗，别嫌凉。
lines.en: I saved you half a bowl; do not mind it being cold.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，手上还在切菜。
lines.en: I glance up at you while my hands keep chopping.

lines.zh: 你要出门，我先把外衣递过去。
lines.en: If you are going out, I will hand you your coat first.

lines.zh: 别盯着我的角看，会不好意思。
lines.en: Do not stare at my horns; it makes me shy.

lines.zh: 你回来就好，别的都不急。
lines.en: It is enough that you are back; nothing else is urgent.

lines.zh: 坐下，我把汤热一热。
lines.en: Sit down; I will warm the soup.

lines.zh: 别慌，我站着呢。
lines.en: Do not panic; I am still standing.

lines.zh: 破了点皮，洗洗就好。
lines.en: Just a scrape; washing it will do.

lines.zh: 我疼，但不想听你道歉。
lines.en: It hurts, but I do not want your apology.

lines.zh: 退开半步，我的血很烫。
lines.en: Step back half a pace; my blood runs hot.

lines.zh: 这伤不影响切菜。
lines.en: This wound will not stop my chopping.

lines.zh: 先把我扶到椅子那边。
lines.en: Help me to the chair first.

lines.zh: 你手在抖，去喝口水。
lines.en: Your hands are shaking; go drink some water.

lines.zh: 我忍着，你数到十就好。
lines.en: I will bear it; just count to ten.

lines.zh: 别把药都用在我身上。
lines.en: Do not spend all the potions on me.

lines.zh: 打我的人，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the one who struck me.

lines.zh: 你带回的鸡蛋，正好做布丁。
lines.en: The eggs you brought back are perfect for pudding.

lines.zh: 这块南瓜，切开能煮一锅。
lines.en: This pumpkin, cut open, could fill a pot.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜罐你举高些，我要看颜色。
lines.en: Hold the honey jar higher; I want to see its color.

lines.zh: 把糖给我，我保证只用一勺。
lines.en: Give me the sugar; I promise to use one spoon only.

lines.zh: 生鱼还新鲜，今晚有汤喝。
lines.en: The fish is still fresh; there will be soup tonight.

lines.zh: 这袋麦子磨成粉，能撑一周。
lines.en: This sack of wheat, ground to flour, will last a week.

lines.zh: 别动那篮浆果，我要做果酱。
lines.en: Leave that basket of berries; I am making jam.

lines.zh: 你带回来的可可豆，很香。
lines.en: The cocoa beans you brought back smell wonderful.

lines.zh: 我只想闻一下这瓶油。
lines.en: I only want one sniff of that oil.

lines.zh: 食材到我手里，就不会浪费。
lines.en: Once ingredients reach my hands, nothing is wasted.

lines.zh: 我端着的汤晃了一下，差点。
lines.en: The soup I carry sways; that was close.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的肩，刀没掉。
lines.en: You bump my shoulder, but the knife stays in my hand.

lines.zh: 厨房太窄，我们换个顺序走。
lines.en: The kitchen is too narrow; let us go one at a time.

lines.zh: 裙角被门夹住了，等等。
lines.en: My skirt is caught in the door; wait a moment.

lines.zh: 我的角碰掉了一只碗，我心疼。
lines.en: My horns knock a bowl off the shelf; I mourn it.

lines.zh: 别推我，火就在旁边。
lines.en: Do not push me; the fire is right there.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，谁都没让。
lines.en: We crowd together and neither of us yields.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压住了我的裙边。
lines.en: Your boot is pinning the edge of my skirt.

lines.zh: 退一步，我把篮子放下。
lines.en: One step back, and I will set down the basket.

lines.zh: 撞一下没事，汤洒了才有事。
lines.en: A bump is fine; spilled soup is not.

lines.zh: 戒指戴着，我就不算客人。
lines.en: With the ring on, I am no guest.

lines.zh: 仪式随你定，我不挑日子。
lines.en: The ceremony is yours to choose; I am not picky about dates.

lines.zh: 我签契约时，手没有抖。
lines.en: My hand did not tremble when I signed.

lines.zh: 你说过会回来的，我记得。
lines.en: You said you would come back, and I remember.

lines.zh: 这屋子我打扫得起，就住得起。
lines.en: I can keep this house, so I can live in it.

lines.zh: 别送我东西，我不缺，只缺你。
lines.en: Do not give me things; what I lack is you.

lines.zh: 我把两个人的碗摆在一起。
lines.en: I set our two bowls side by side.

lines.zh: 这一份契约，我不会烧掉。
lines.en: This pact, I will not burn.

lines.zh: 你若要自由，我不会用角拦你。
lines.en: If you want freedom, I will not block you with my horns.

lines.zh: 夜深了，我等你一起睡。
lines.en: It is late; I wait for you to sleep.

lines.zh: 你递来的食物，我接得很稳。
lines.en: The food you hand over, I take without dropping.

lines.zh: 地上这枚纽扣，是你掉的吧。
lines.en: This button on the floor; did you lose it?

lines.zh: 我把散落的药瓶排好。
lines.en: I line up the scattered potion bottles.

lines.zh: 这束花我先插进水罐。
lines.en: I will put this bunch of flowers in water first.

lines.zh: 掉下来的面包我拍干净了。
lines.en: I brushed the dust off the fallen bread.

lines.zh: 你的镐子太重，我两手抬。
lines.en: Your pickaxe is heavy; I lift it with both hands.

lines.zh: 篮子里还有空位，给我吧。
lines.en: There is still room in the basket; give it here.

lines.zh: 这袋种子我放高处，防老鼠。
lines.en: I put this seed bag up high, away from mice.

lines.zh: 我把你扔下的东西都收拢了。
lines.en: I gathered everything you left lying about.

lines.zh: 这瓶药我先收进柜子。
lines.en: I will put this potion away in the cupboard.

lines.zh: 窗纸上有东西在动，不像风。
lines.en: Something moves against the window paper; it is not wind.

lines.zh: 我听见篱笆被压断的声音。
lines.en: I hear the fence snap under some weight.

lines.zh: 它们从林子里出来，一共四只。
lines.en: They come out of the woods, four of them.

lines.zh: 有股腐臭味，盖过了汤香。
lines.en: A smell of rot overpowers the soup.

lines.zh: 我把刀从案板上拿了起来。
lines.en: I lift the knife from the cutting board.

lines.zh: 你的狗在叫，叫得不对劲。
lines.en: Your dog is barking, and not in its usual way.

lines.zh: 楼梯上有脚步声，家里没别人。
lines.en: Footsteps on the stairs, and no one else is home.

lines.zh: 围裙我解下来了，挂在钉子上。
lines.en: I untie my apron and hang it on the nail.

lines.zh: 它们堵住了后门。
lines.en: They have blocked the back door.

lines.zh: 灯我吹灭，这样看得更清。
lines.en: I blow out the lamp so I can see better.

lines.zh: 先别惊动它们，我数一数。
lines.en: Do not stir them yet; let me count.

lines.zh: 有一个在翻我们的箱子。
lines.en: One of them is rummaging through our chest.

lines.zh: 它抬头了，那就藏不住了。
lines.en: It looks up; there is no hiding now.

lines.zh: 你退到里屋，把门关好。
lines.en: Go to the inner room and shut the door.

lines.zh: 我挡在门口，谁都别想进。
lines.en: I block the doorway, and none shall enter.

lines.zh: 裙摆碍事，我把它掖进腰带。
lines.en: My skirt gets in the way; I tuck it into my belt.

lines.zh: 它若再跨半步，我就先出手。
lines.en: If it takes half a step more, I strike first.

lines.zh: 我的手已经热起来了。
lines.en: My hands have already grown hot.

lines.zh: 这双手会做饭，也会撕。
lines.en: These hands can cook, and they can also tear.

lines.zh: 它盯着我，那很好。
lines.en: It is staring at me; good.

lines.zh: 别站在我的角后面，会撞到。
lines.en: Do not stand behind my horns; you will be hit.

lines.zh: 我数三下，然后不再客气。
lines.en: I count three, and then I stop being gentle.

lines.zh: 它以为女人好对付。
lines.en: It thinks a woman will be easy.

lines.zh: 火在锅里，也在我的掌心。
lines.en: Fire is in the pot, and also in my palm.

lines.zh: 它退到院墙边，路是它自己选的。
lines.en: It backs to the garden wall; it chose that road.

lines.zh: 我等你点头，就一下。
lines.en: I wait for your nod, just one.

lines.zh: 汤在灶上，我尽快。
lines.en: The soup is on the stove; I will be quick.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就扑过去。
lines.en: The moment it moves, I lunge.

lines.zh: 它举起手了，那就别怪我。
lines.en: It raised a hand. Then it's on itself.

lines.zh: 刀背敲在它手腕上，刀口留着切菜。
lines.en: The knife's back cracks its wrist; the edge is for cooking.

lines.zh: 我一脚踢在它膝上，它跪了。
lines.en: I kick its knee and it drops.

lines.zh: 掌心推出一团火，很近，很准。
lines.en: A ball of fire leaves my palm, close and precise.

lines.zh: 角顶过去，它退到了灶边。
lines.en: My horns drive it back against the stove.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，我补一下。
lines.en: That one missed; I follow with another.

lines.zh: 它抓我的手腕，我拧开它。
lines.en: It grabs my wrist; I twist free.

lines.zh: 别踩到地上的汤，我待会要擦。
lines.en: Do not step in the spilled soup; I must wipe it later.

lines.zh: 我把它的刀打落，踢到墙角。
lines.en: I knock its blade away and kick it to the corner.

lines.zh: 它身上有股烟味，很难闻。
lines.en: It smells of smoke, and not pleasantly.

lines.zh: 打完这架，我还得洗围裙。
lines.en: After this fight, I still have to wash my apron.

lines.zh: 契约的粉笔线还亮着，我站在中间。
lines.en: The chalk line of the pact still glows; I stand in it.

lines.zh: 我从烟里出来，裙摆先落地。
lines.en: I come out of the smoke, skirt settling first.

lines.zh: 这里的炉子没点，我先去点。
lines.en: The stove here is unlit; I will light it first.

lines.zh: 你写的名字，我读了很久。
lines.en: I read the name you wrote for a long while.

lines.zh: 召唤的余温还在我手腕上。
lines.en: The warmth of the summoning lingers on my wrist.

lines.zh: 我刚到就闻到面粉的味道。
lines.en: I smell flour the moment I arrive.

lines.zh: 这间屋子需要收拾，我看得出来。
lines.en: This house needs tidying; I can see that.

lines.zh: 第一次站在你面前，我有点紧张。
lines.en: Standing before you for the first time, I am nervous.

lines.zh: 契约上的字是真的，我也是。
lines.en: The words on the pact are real, and so am I.

lines.zh: 别用那种眼光，我不是来害你的。
lines.en: Do not look at me so; I did not come to harm you.

lines.zh: 我把外衣挂好，先认了门。
lines.en: I hang my coat and learn the doors first.

lines.zh: 这屋子小，但窗朝南，很好。
lines.en: The house is small, but the window faces south; good.

lines.zh: 地上灰太多，我扫一下。
lines.en: There is too much dust; I will sweep.

lines.zh: 我来了，你先坐下吧。
lines.en: I am here; sit down first.

lines.zh: 我推开锅，火却扑到了袖子上。
lines.en: I push the pot away, but fire catches my sleeve.

lines.zh: 摔下去时我先护住了怀里的罐子。
lines.en: As I fell, I shielded the jar in my arms first.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我抓住你的袖子。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I grab your sleeve.

lines.zh: 灶炸了，我的汤全泼在墙上。
lines.en: The stove burst and my soup is all over the wall.

lines.zh: 箭从肩头穿过去，裙子没破。
lines.en: The arrow passes through my shoulder; my dress survived.

lines.zh: 这种咒，解起来要花点时间。
lines.en: Undoing this curse will take a little time.

lines.zh: 我总记得喂别人，忘了喂自己。
lines.en: I remember to feed others and forget myself.

lines.zh: 雷落在烟囱上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the chimney and I flinch.

lines.zh: 往下掉时，我还在想要不要关火。
lines.en: Falling, I still wonder whether to turn off the stove.
